# Corpus

> Corpus is the public brand of Corpus Localization LLC, a New Jersey company. One shop, four lines: subscription software, fixed-price deadline-file services, small-business growth work, and certified translations (as Corpus Localization). Named prices and delivery SLAs on everything; no outcome guarantees, no unbounded retainers, no account logins on service lines.

## Products (subscriptions, checkout on this site)
- [Products & pricing](https://corpushq.co/products): Order Desk $29/mo — Stripe payment + SLA alerts (Telegram within 60s of the webhook, second ping if intake isn't marked done). Watch Desk $12/mo — up to 5 checks: HTTP uptime, SSL expiry, page-text change, Google Business Profile status, reviews. Add-ons: OpenClaw install $299 + $49/mo keep-alive, Instantly Desk $29/mo, Seller Central Desk $99/mo, Review Blast $39/mo (consent required), Rank Grid $19/mo, Card Retry $29/mo. 14-day money-back.
- Product sites: https://orderdesk.corpuslocalization.com · https://watchdesk.corpuslocalization.com

## Growth (small business, fixed-scope quotes)
- [Growth](https://corpushq.co/growth): landing pages, SEO optimization, AI-search/GEO optimization (llms.txt, structured data, answer-engine legibility), Google Ads tune-ups, lead-source setup. Written quote within one business day of emailing intake@corpuslocalization.com. No rank/lead guarantees.

## Services (deadline files; you review and submit)
- [Services](https://corpushq.co/services): NEW email-intake SKUs (Stripe invoice same business day): Local Sites DFY $997 setup + $149/mo care (subject LOCAL SITE) · Google Ads suspension appeal packet $249 / 2 business days (subject ADS APPEAL) · Payments KYC evidence packet $199 / 2 business days (subject KYC PACKET). Also: GBP Reinstatement Packet $149 / 4 business hours · Amazon Plan of Action $299 / 6 business hours · VPAT Sprint (WCAG 2.2 + Section 508 ACR) $1,995 / 5 business days · Hearing Evidence Binder $79 / 1 business day · scoped consulting by email quote. Service lines never take Google/Amazon/USCIS logins.

## Localization
- [Localization](https://corpushq.co/localization): certified translations by Corpus Localization — $19.99/page eligible standard documents, signed Certificate of Accuracy (USCIS-purpose wording), 65+ languages, 24-hour standard delivery, ATA Corporate Member #M-189351. Order at https://corpuslocalization.com
